acceptance: The Velox image builds for linux/amd64
The container starts the Spark Connect server and BenchBox imports inside it
description: `docker/velox/Dockerfile` now copies `/uv` and `/uvx` from `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.13.5` instead of running `pip install uv` with the base image's pip. Only the base image plus that uv install was smoke-tested (arm64); the full image is amd64-only and needs the Gluten release tarball, so the complete build, `uv pip install --system "/opt/benchbox[velox]"` and container start-up were not exercised.
